offline.title: Disconnected
offline.message: Cannot reach the dashboard server. Reconnecting shortly.

view.loadFailed: Couldn't load this screen. Reload the page and try again.

profile.logoutConfirm: Sign out? All open windows will be closed.

addons.pluginMissing: This app needs an OpenMediaVault plugin that is not installed.
addons.adminRequired: Only administrators can use this app.

addonWindow.partial: Some information could not be loaded.

containers.podmanUnverified: Podman mode has not been verified with this dashboard. Some information may be wrong.

action.confirmStop: Stop {{name}}? Services running in this container will be unavailable until it is started again.
action.confirmRestart: Restart {{name}}? Services running in this container will be briefly interrupted.

smart.wakeHint: Checking wakes sleeping disks, so it runs automatically only once a day.

action.confirmDisable: Disable {{name}}? OpenMediaVault applies the change right away.
action.confirmDisableSsh: Disable {{name}}? Current SSH sessions may be disconnected, and you will not be able to sign in over SSH until it is enabled again.
action.confirmDisableSamba: Disable {{name}}? Clients using shared folders over SMB will be disconnected.
action.confirmDisableNfs: Disable {{name}}? Clients using NFS exports will be disconnected.
action.confirmDisableRsyncd: Disable {{name}}? Backups and syncs that connect to this rsync server will fail.

services.toggleHint: Only SSH, SMB/CIFS, NFS and the RSync server can be turned on or off here. Configure other services in OpenMediaVault.

elevation.title: Administrator authentication
elevation.description: Enter your password to use root rights in this session for 5 minutes.
elevation.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{remaining}}.
elevation.notAllowed: This account can't use administrator rights.
elevation.reauth: Your helper session has ended. Sign out and sign in again.

linkNotice.title: Open in a new tab
linkNotice.workbench: OMV Workbench opens in a new browser tab. You need to sign in to OMV again in the new tab.

error.action_busy: Another operation on this item is still in progress.
error.action_failed: OMV could not complete the operation. Check the details in OMV.
error.action_timeout: OMV is taking too long to respond. Check the status again in a moment.
error.config_dirty: OMV has pending configuration changes. Apply or revert them in OMV first.
error.plugin_missing: The required OpenMediaVault plugin is not installed.

common.saveFailed: Couldn't save your change. It will be saved with your next change.
common.siteSaveFailed: Couldn't save the setting. The previous value is shown again.

screen.following: Using the default set by an administrator.
screen.taskbarAlignDesc: Where the All apps button and window buttons sit on the taskbar.
screen.widgetLockDesc: Desktop widgets can't be moved, resized, added or removed.

image.deleteConfirm: Delete the uploaded image? If it's in use, the default background will be shown instead.
image.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB.
image.tooLarge: The image is too large. Upload an image of 20 MB or less.
image.unsupported: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images can be uploaded.
image.failed: Couldn't upload or delete the image.

general.animationsDesc: Animate windows, menus and background changes.
general.reducedMotion: Reduce motion is on in your device settings, so animations stay off.

loginScreen.intro: These settings apply to the sign-in screen for everyone. You can see the result after signing out.
loginScreen.backgroundHint: The image is shown before sign-in, so anyone who can reach the dashboard can see it. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB.
loginScreen.easterEggDesc: Shows an animation when the sign-in screen is left idle for 30 seconds.

defaultScreen.intro: Applied to users who haven't chosen their own theme or wallpaper in Screen settings.

server.intro: Settings that Onmaru runs with. The two values below can be changed here; the rest are set in the server's settings file.
server.invalid: The value isn't in a valid format.
server.editableDesc: Takes effect immediately and overrides the value from the settings file.
server.workbenchDesc: Address the browser uses to open the OMV web UI. Leave empty to hide the OMV Workbench app.
server.smartDesc: SMART information is read again once a day after this time (server time).
server.runtimeDesc: Values the server started with and where they came from.
server.howToDesc: These values are environment variables in /etc/default/onmaru. Restart the service after editing. If you change the listen address, update the reverse proxy too.
server.howToInstall: You can also run ./install.sh again from the repository and answer its questions.

helper.title: Privileged helper
helper.desc: A separate service running as root lets Onmaru act with your own Linux account and, after you enter your password again, with root rights for a few minutes.

stateDesc.disabled: Run ./install.sh again and choose to install the helper.
stateDesc.unavailable: Onmaru can't reach the helper. Check systemctl status onmaru-helper.socket on the server.
stateDesc.none: The helper didn't accept this account when you signed in (for example a system account, or it was unreachable). Signing in again retries.
stateDesc.reauth: The helper restarted and no longer knows this session. Sign out and sign in again.
stateDesc.active: This session can use the helper.

helper.rootDesc: Needed by some administrator features. Ends automatically after 5 minutes.
helper.notAllowed: This account can't elevate. It must be in openmediavault-admin and in the helper's elevate group (sudo by default).

editor.title: Edit photo
editor.view: Photo position. Drag or use the arrow keys to move it, and + or - to zoom.
editor.hint: Drag to position the photo. The circle becomes your profile photo.

profile.removePhotoConfirm: Remove your profile photo? The default avatar will be shown instead.
profile.loadFailed: Couldn't load your account information from OMV.

readOnly.system: This is a built-in OMV system account, so its email and tags can't be changed.
readOnly.locked: Changes to this account are disabled in OMV.

profile.savedPending: Saved. OMV now has a pending change; an administrator needs to apply it in the OMV web UI.
profile.saveConfigDirty: Not saved: OMV has changes that haven't been applied yet. Apply them in the OMV web UI first.
profile.saveApplyFailed: Your account information was changed, but applying it in OMV failed. Apply it in the OMV web UI.
profile.saveBusy: Your previous change is still being saved.
profile.omvHintAdmin: Change the password, groups and more on the OMV user edit page. It opens in a new tab.
profile.omvHintSystem: The built-in OMV administrator account isn't listed in OMV user management.
profile.omvHintNoWorkbench: Set the OMV Workbench address in Server settings to open the OMV user edit page from here.
profile.omvHintUser: An administrator can change your password and other account details in the OMV web UI.
profile.tagsDesc: Same as Tags in OMV user management. Separate tags with a comma or Enter.
profile.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
profile.tagsInvalid: Tags can't contain commas (,) or colons (:), and together must be 255 bytes and 32 tags or fewer.
profile.invalid: Check the email address and tags.
profile.saveDescAdmin: Saving applies the change in OMV right away.
profile.saveDescUser: After saving, an administrator applies the pending change in the OMV web UI.
